philippines.title: Over 5,200 applied in Negros during 1st week of voter registration
philippines.description:
BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — A total of 5,236 voter applications were processed in the Negros Island Region (NIR) during the first week of voter registration from Nov. 10 to 14. Female applicants outnumbered male applicants, with 2,800 women and 2,436 men registering, based on data from the Commission on Elections (Comelec)-NIR. Negros Occidental recorded the highest number of applications at 3,345, comprising 1,534 males and 1,811 females. Negros Oriental followed with 1,765 applications (829 males and 936 females), while Siquijor recorded 126 (73 males and 53 females).
